init_distributed_mode: initialize distributed training mode for single GPU, multi-GPU, multi-node, or SLURM jobs using params object
init_signal_handler: install signal handlers to handle SLURM time limit and pre-emption signals for cluster jobs
sig_handler: handle SIGUSR1 signal by requeuing the SLURM job on the master process and logging rank info
term_handler: handle SIGTERM signal by logging a warning and bypassing termination for graceful shutdown
review_slurm_module: review the slurm module functions for distributed training setup and SLURM signal handling
